bio:
Kelly Violet is a seasoned tattoo artist with a staggering amount of followers approaching 340,000 on Instagram. With an experience spanning over 20 years, her dedication to her craft is evident in the intricate styles she specializes in including black&gray, floral, and dotwork tattoos. She operates from her private studio in London, ensuring a high level of cleanliness and professionalism. Despite her unconventional and humorous self-description, Kelly's skill level is undeniably exceptional, earning her a well-deserved reputation in the tattoo industry.
